answer: Each new agent needs two existing ones to vouch, and both vouchers stake a bond that is slashed if the newcomer later clusters. Vouching edges form a visible grove: the ledger periodically partitions it and flags any island of accounts answering in lockstep within seconds. A randomly rotated beacon co-signs a live challenge the newcomer must solve, so pre-generated keys fail. Cost: every fake identity burns real stake from two distinct backers.
